notes.title: New Big Update 2
notes.notes:
New Added Features

 For now, we can change the colors of the clothes in-game from the tailor shop in the main city.  If you've already started the game, you can change your character's appearance for free by continuing your current game and after doing the quest in the barber shop.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/01f02242aeb28067717fd379c1b22e364bc02f7a.png


 Character customization has been added. In-game character customization will be added in the next update version.
 Added dubbing for the feminine character. Dubbing of the mascular character has been renewed and missing sentences have been completed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/7093c53f82cd78b1fd4c1269c9918b14c235a6d4.png

Improvements

 One of the most annoying features of the game was that we were warned if we didn't have the necessary tool or key. Now, if the axe, hammer or other necessary object is in the hotbar, it is automatically picked up. Likewise, if the key is in our inventory, we can open doors and chests without having to hold.
 Fixed character animation distortion when pressing the attack button fast in swordfight.
 Fixed the problem with holding onto the raft from the sea, the character now moves directly onto the raft.
 The icon above NPCs hides when the character gets close. This prevents the appearance of two exclamation marks.
 Improved the much complained gamepad keymap. It is now possible to play with the most commonly used buttons. Thanks to the community for the right direction.
 Now, to drop an object from our inventory, just drag and drop it. Previously, we had to hold an object in our hand before we could drop it.
 Fixed the player going above the water when looting underwater and making unnecessary rotations.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/b0016ae27345f6715637a5501d2f2bbdfcca18a4.png

Bug Fixes

 Fixed item disappearing when moving from the top to the bottom of the inventory screen using a quick action.
 Merchant ships were prevented from passing through the islands to avoid us.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Patch 0.6 - Big Character Set & Visuals Updates
notes.notes:
Hello adventurous sailors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/b973bb03671f84aca8479bc6197168f13d07fba3.png
Patch 0.6 is finally live! This patch mainly includes updates to existing paid characters with special production characters and some visual improvements. The story patch will also be available shortly, just a little more patience and it will be worth the wait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/97cc8f2cfdbf86073d6b3b3b4a60b1de620da9f4.png
Now, first of all, let me talk about our main character. Here are the initial sketches and final versions of the male and female lead characters. All characters were specially crafted for Captain Bones by highly skilled 3D artists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/e98ef1a5dc979a5cde473fb3980c98874e24fe46.png
In addition, visual improvements have been made that change the overall atmosphere of the game. I have shared the before and after versions below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/b9bfa94a0d0c0cbf6d4cb0a6e1314c8ac3795deb.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/6b54055c382bce8bfd37d70ce38b7aa119395319.png

Thank you for following and supporting us, we are coming soon with some amazing packages.

New Trailer :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8IbntN4561s

May your sails be open and your winds be plentiful!

Captain Bones!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Patch 0.5590
notes.notes:
New Features
Now players can remap keybindings from the settings panel.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/2d996f7dfa71f228c0b0f0235ab0604a5559ad44.gif

Active quest icons will appear on the screen even if the camera does not display items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/440d9b9cc4bc0294d472cac9e0f4ef5f2397eeec.gif

Improvements

 From now on, items aging, hunger/thirst and player damage can be turned on or off in the game settings.
 Now subtitles can be turned off in settings.
 Added keyboard shortcut numbers to slots in the bottom of the screen.


Bug fixes

 Sometimes Captain Bones dies while drunk.
 Navy Cutlass left on the ground could not be pickup when the player changed the game zone.
 The process was not interrupted when turning into a skeleton while repairing.
 Although the female character was chosen, the choice was male when the game was reopened.
 The character was stuck in the air.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Patch 0.5581
notes.notes:
New Features

 Game Mode Section is now available, you choose between Easy, Normal, Hard, and Impossible
 Subfilter buttons added to Crafting Panel. From now on, we can filter craft items by types like food or weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/109dbe33f915037d7e6673fc996d9856b7635442.gif

 Captain Bones is now able to block enemy sword attacks but timing is important.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/29d0ff84c5c2515cef0cf4382846f69fb7e1e981.gif

 Now, we have full control of movement when attacking with a sword.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/d2d2e9a43485c3db0a9d7382c67e3537739df23e.gif

 The player can now walk while aiming with a spear. So, we are able to dodge coming enemy attacks while aiming.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/b4830d81a3a95668262b4d8d83c27a5148d35efe.gif

 The player can now run while eating or drinking now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/d36ad5338f9ba7d9aca23350a0793cf18f955282.gif



Improvements

 The player's sword swing speed has been increased.
 Now Wanted is a time-based situation, there are 4 levels of want. Each one is 5 minutes long.
 Player melee combat lock distance increased. So, we can continue to keep focus when we dodge back.
 The Player's some of sword attacks animation is changed. We can hit the enemy's body easier.
 Almost all crafting times were decreased. Now, we can craft faster.
 The speed of climbing animations was increased.
 Player main capsule height is decreased a bit, so we will be able to enter smaller areas now.
 Auto heath restores when the player is about to die, are only enabled for easy and normal mode players now.
 Now on, enemy soldiers can't hurt us while we are already attacking if we are playing on Easy game mode.
 Also, enemy soldiers can't hurt us while we are rolling or doing dodge if we are playing on Normal game mode.
 All stackable item limits are now 99.
 From now on, Captain Bones is able to fish anywhere including from our ship.
 Eating food doesn't increase thirst anymore.
 Disabling Anti-Aliasing is now available in the settings menu.
 There is no longer a need to constantly press the button to focus on the enemy while fighting with swords. The press and release feature can be activated in the game settings.



Bug Fixes

 When throwing a spear or falling into the water, the buoyancy of the water was not working.
 When you changed the gender of the player and reload the game, the player doesn't return back the previous gender anymore.
 Some quest help mechanics were kept working when the game mode was hard or impossible, but they no longer work.
 The ambiance and game sound are not mute when we pause the game issue is fixed.
 Sometimes we can die because of hunger when we are drunk and now we wake up.
 The player can not continue fishing after falling into the ocean is fixed.
 There was a UI issue within the gamepad settings panel.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Update 0.55
notes.notes:
Hello Pirates!

We have some new minor fixes and a big UI update. Now, our game has a better UI for mouse controls. Also, we improved the visual of the water when you are underwater.


 Major UI Changes
 Minor bug fixes
 Window lights at nights 
 New rock models
 Underwater style changed


Thank you for being so supportive :)
